jobs.occupation: Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d) (Leichtflugzeugbauer/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our international flight training activities, AutoGyro is looking for a qualified and experienced Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d).

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high quality flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments. You will work in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations as well as internal standards and contribute to maintaining and developing our global training quality.

The position combines hands on flight instruction with close collaboration across engineering, sales and after sales functions. You will operate in an international environment and represent AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context.

The activity is based on site at our location in Hildesheim, with occasional international assignments.

The role can alternatively be structured as a cooperation with self employed flight instructors (m/f/d) or flight schools. This includes the delivery of training under the AutoGyro framework and alignment with defined standards and procedures.

Become part of our dynamic team and actively contribute to the success of our company. You can expect attractive conditions as well as free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Delivery of flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments
- Instruction and supervision of students in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations and internal standards
- Execution of check flights, proficiency checks and refresher training
- Customer handover flights and aircraft familiarisation
- Assessment of student performance and documentation of training progress
- Contribution to the continuous development of training concepts and standards in line with international requirements
- Close coordination with engineering, sales and after sales in relation to aircraft and customer requirements
- Representation of AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context

Requirements

- Valid Flight Instructor qualification for gyroplane or a comparable instructor licence with willingness to convert
- Proven flight experience, ideally within ultralight or gyroplane aviation
- Strong instructional capability with a structured and safety oriented approach
- Sound understanding of aviation regulations and operational procedures
- High level of responsibility, reliability and professional judgement
- Confident communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel occasionally, including international assignments

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

The interdisciplinary research focus lies in the investigation of the development, diversity, and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun, and solar-like stars. MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g., ESA, NASA) and conducts cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

For the development of a plasma spectrometer to be flown on the ESA M7-Mission "Plasma Observatory" PMO, the institute is looking for a

Project Scientist (m/f/d)

This position is subject to financing that has not yet been confirmed. As a project scientist you will work as part of an international team on the definition and development of a scientific space instrument in close contact with the project team and external partners at home and abroad.

Your Tasks

- Scientific project lead and contact person to ESA
- Contribute to plasma spectrometer design
- Modelling of plasma spectrometer performance
- Supervision of plasma spectrometer calibration
- Analyse, display, and interpret plasma spectrometer data from previous multi-spacecraft missions in the Earth Magnetosphere – relevant for PMO science
- Perform and interpret MHD and hybrid simulation runs at the boundaries of the Earth magnetosphere specifically designed for the trajectories of the seven PMO spacecraft
- Develop and implement data analysis tools for plasma spectrometer data
- Present scientific results at international conferences, team meetings, project-related meetings, and publish in refereed journals

Your Qualification

- University degree (PhD) in physics or space engineering
- Knowledge in plasma measurement techniques
- Strong understanding of relevant physical concepts and state-of-the-art space/plasma instrumentation
- Knowledge of common programming tools (Python, etc.)
- Knowledge of ion optics simulation tools
- Strong skills in management and organisation
- Ability to work in a structured manner and to document the work
- Willingness to travel internationally
- Good knowledge of English

You should have

• High motivation, problem solving attitude, be a continuous learner, and       team player
• Background knowledge in geophysics, plasma physics or astrophysics
• Experience in experimental physics
• Experience in managing smaller projects
• Experience in space projects (ESA, NASA, etc.) is of advantage

- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

We are currently looking for a Logistics Cost Analyst (d/f/m) to join our team in Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel.

We are a diverse, highly collaborative team of supply chain and logistics experts driving operational excellence and cost efficiency across European central and regional distribution centers in the aerospace spare parts aftermarket. As our regional organisation evolves, you will work closely alongside team leads and operational specialists across international sites to steer financial performance and support strategic decision-making.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary:

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/ paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM

- You will deploy a high-precision financial monitoring system across all European locations to deliver complete spend transparency.
- You will lead the annual operational planning process, monitor actuals against plans, run root-cause analyses for deviations, and manage global financial risks and opportunities.
- You will oversee purchase order execution for business services, consumables, facility operations, and equipment while ensuring budget compliance.
- You will benchmark and analyze supplier contracts for outsourced warehouse operations, initiate cost reduction initiatives, and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, goods receipts, and invoices.
- You will contribute to the global logistics transformation roadmap by building project business cases, unit cost models, and make-or-buy analyses.
- You will design and roll out financial key performance indicators (KPIs) that empower operational teams to boost cost efficiency.
- You will develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships across different departments, sites, and service providers in an international environment.

ABOUT YOU

Equipped with a degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related discipline, paired with professional experience in logistics cost controlling or contract logistics, we are looking for a team player with the following experience, skills and mindset:

- You hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
- You bring solid professional experience in supply chain financial steering and contract logistics.
- You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data analytics tools.
- You show proven ability to build collaborative business relationships and communicate effectively across international teams.
- You feature a structured, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset combined with strong organizational capabilities.
- You possess business fluency in both German and English.

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

jobs.occupation: Chartering Broker (f/m/d) – Regional Trade & Project Cargo (Intra-Europe) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Trampfahrt)
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   

We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.

Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. 

Fleet Optimization & Chartering 

Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). 

Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.

Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation 

Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. 

Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. 

Market Integration & Collaboration 

Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. 

Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. 

Qualifications & Experience 

 Essential Criteria 

- Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. 
- Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. 
- Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. 
- Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. 

Core Skills 

- Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. 
- Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). 
- Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.
